author: K. T. Gardner
title: Grant Campbell highlights Medicaid reform and anti-Semitism collaboration in recent posts - South Raleigh News
text:
Grant Campbell, a Republican member of the North Carolina State House representing the 83rd district, has recently posted updates on social media addressing legislative priorities and community engagement.
On September 14, 2025, Campbell shared a legislative update regarding Medicaid reform. He stated, “SUNDAY UPDATE: Medicaid Update and Remembering Charlie Kirk. @NCHouseGOP is ready to solve the Medicaid problem without attaching unrelated spending. #ncpol https://t.co/9jw4MCMxYa”.
Two days later, on September 16, 2025, Campbell highlighted his recent engagements with local organizations and international representatives. He wrote, “Busy few days. Spoke to NC Grange on Friday and NC Society of Anesthesiologists on Saturday. Productive meeting today with @EitanWeiss, Israeli Consul General of the Southeast US today to collaborate on combating Anti-Semitism. #ncpol https://t.co/0Bs4nowqL6”.
Later that same day, Campbell recognized Gynecologic Cancer Awareness Month by sharing statistics about cancer diagnoses in women and emphasizing prevention efforts: “September is Gynecologic Cancer Awareness Month. More than 100,000 women in the US are diagnosed each year. Screening and awareness can save lives. #GCAM #EndGynecologicCancer https://t.co/871zpeNFZp”.
Campbell was elected to the North Carolina State House in 2025 for District 83 after succeeding Kevin Crutchfield.
